# v3 reconnect golden transcript. One `name<space>lowercase-hex` per line.
# input.* are fixed inputs; the rest are outputs both sides must reproduce
# byte for byte. Integers are little-endian. record.counter_* are host -> iPad
# records that must open with that counter under the responder->initiator key;
# each seals input.counter_inner_type || input.counter_body.
# reject_auth.* must fail authentication under a fresh opener or handshake
# state for this session (record_media_session_flipped: the opener for the
# flipped id; record_input_reflected: the responder->initiator key).
# reject_framing.* must not parse. reject_limit.* must be refused before
# the AEAD.
# Regenerate only on a deliberate wire change:
# UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p eternal-wire --lib v3::golden
